subject: Coordination: MAP, evaluation plan & sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form (HelioMed)
messages:
From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@heliomed.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and sequencing request for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency/throughput story. Procurement has asked me to pull together a mutual action plan so legal, security and purchasing can see the gating path to signature.

High level ask: can Redwood provide a MAP that shows milestone owners, expected durations, and the artifacts needed for each gate (e.g., SOC2 evidence, DPA language, SOW/order form template, procurement PO timeline)? We expect a security questionnaire and legal review to take most of the time.

Important notes from our side:
- We cannot accept vendor-hosted data retention outside our EU region for the pilot (we'll confirm exact region later).
- We prefer to have the MSA redlines surfaced before the order form is finalized.

Target timeline from HelioMed: start evaluation week of Aug 4, decision window mid-September. Can you sketch sequencing and dependency order so our teams can align?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Hart
Head of Partnerships, HelioMed
[attachment: HelioMed_RFP_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Emily Hart <emily.hart@heliomed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and sequencing request for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Emily — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks.

Attached is a first-pass MAP and dependency timeline that maps evaluation gates to legal/procurement artifacts and owners. Key highlights:

1) Evaluation run (Aug 4–Aug 22):
   - Redwood provides hosted trial environment, test dataset, and a short checklist for performance verification. Owner: Dylan (Eng + Solutions).
   - Outcome: acceptance sign-off to move to procurement review.

2) Security & compliance (parallel, Aug 11–Aug 29):
   - Deliverables: SOC2 summary, data residency note, security questionnaire (we'll fill HelioMed's template). Owner: Karthik (Security/Infra).

3) Legal (MSA/DPA) review (Aug 18–Sep 5):
   - We can circulate MSA_v3 with track changes. Ideally legal does an initial redline pass, then we schedule a 30-min working session to resolve major items. Owner: Laura (Legal).

4) Procurement (order form and PO) (Aug 25–Sep 12):
   - Order form references the agreed SOW and pricing. We'll publish the order form template early so procurement can validate internal PO fields. Owner: Marissa (Sales Ops).

Dependencies and suggested cadence:
- MSA redlines should be finished before finalizing order form (recommended).
- Security questionnaire completion should not block the legal redline loop but may push signature if data residency needs more work.
- If HelioMed requests Dedicated (private) deployment, that adds 2–3 weeks for networking/KM configuration and will shift the close window.

I've attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners) and a draft order-of-operations summary. Please review and flag any HelioMed-specific gating items.

Propose a 30-minute sync Wed 23 Jul at 10am PT to walk the plan and agree owners — does that work?

Best,
Dylan
Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Emily Hart <emily.hart@heliomed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and sequencing request for MSA/DPA/order form

Emily, Dylan — thanks for the draft. A couple of practical notes from Legal that will affect sequencing:

- We'll push MSA_v3 with inline comments by end of day Thu 24 Jul. That initial pass should resolve the majority of standard commercial terms.
- DPA: we'll propose a standard Redwood DPA; if HelioMed requires bespoke clauses around data residency, that will need a scoped SOW addendum and may require engineering sign-off on export controls.
- Order form: please don't finalize pricing fields until we've agreed essential liability and indemnity language; procurement can do parallel form validation (fields & PO number flow) but signature must wait on legal agreement unless procurement uses conditional PO.

Suggested sequencing tweak: run legal redlines and a 1-hr cross-functional working session the week of Aug 4 (parallel with evaluation), then finalize order form the next week (Aug 11–15) so procurement has time for internal approvals. That tightens the overall timeline and targets a signature window around late Aug/early Sep.

I'll attach preliminary redlines and a short notes doc to capture open items.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[attachment: MSA_v3_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Emily Hart <emily.hart@heliomed.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@heliomed.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and sequencing request for MSA/DPA/order form

Team — this looks good and helps us a lot. A few quick replies: 

- The timeline aligns with our internal windows; we can run the pilot Aug 4–22.
- Data residency: we will flag the EU-residency constraint for the pilot in the questionnaire. If Redwood can confirm an EU-hosted trial, that removes a big blocker.
- We accept a working session during the first week of the evaluation. Can you send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 6 9:30am PT?

Action items from HelioMed:
- I'll circulate our security questionnaire to Dylan and Karthik by EOD Fri.
- Procurement will validate the order form fields and send any required PO templates.

Let's use the shared Drive folder for artifacts (works best for our team). Emily

Emily Hart
Head of Partnerships, HelioMed
[attachment: HelioMed_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)]
